move: notification springs down, expands to receipt with counter, collapses away
how: A white notification card starts at y -220, scale .94, invisible on a soft gradient stage. At 3% it drops to rest with elastic.out(1,.65) over 0.9s, its green icon spinning in from rotation -30 with back.out(2.5) and a green check badge popping at 12% with back.out(3). At 27% the card dips to scale .98 and a hidden detail panel expands from height 0 to its measured height with expo.out over 0.8s while the amount counts to $4,200.00 (expo.out, 1.3s) and the meta grid and buttons stagger up. The Done button presses at 71%; at 78% the panel collapses with expo.inOut, the badge shrinks away and the card lifts back off-screen with power3.in at 86%; set() calls at the last frame reset the counter and rows.
adapt: Replace the app name, message, amount, the four meta fields and button labels, and the green gradient; keep the elastic.out(1,.65) drop and the 0.8s expo.out expand.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card from shot and measures the detail height after layout; animate returns the timeline with drop at 0.03D, expand at 0.27D, collapse at 0.78D and exit at 0.86D. The height tween needs the offsetHeight read inside el after mount; from() tweens on the rows need immediateRender:false if composed.
caveats: detail height is measured with offsetHeight at build time, so fonts must be loaded first
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when composed
